curriculum.subject: Mathematical Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: appreciate the use of money in buying items from shops.

mission.title: appreciate the use of money in buying items from shops.

interactions.prompt: Mum takes money to the shop. What can money help Mum do?
interactions.feedback: Yes! Money helps us buy bread at a shop.
interactions.retryHint: Think about what a shop sells.

interactions.prompt: Help the lion match the coin to the shop basket. Tap the coin, then tap the basket.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the Kenyan coin, then tap the shop basket.
interactions.feedback: Good! We use money when we buy things from a shop.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the thing used to pay and the place where we buy.

interactions.prompt: Amina wants milk from the kiosk. What should she take to pay?
interactions.feedback: Correct! Amina can use money to buy milk.
interactions.retryHint: Pick the thing people use to pay in a shop.

interactions.prompt: Tap the things that a shop can sell. Money helps us buy these things.
interactions.feedback: Well done! Money can help us buy useful things from shops.
interactions.retryHint: Choose things you may see on a shop shelf.

interactions.prompt: At a market, Otieno gives money and gets oranges. Why did he give money?
interactions.feedback: Great thinking! He used money to buy oranges.
interactions.retryHint: Money is used when we want to get an item from a seller.

interactions.prompt: Show what you know. Match money to the item you can buy at the shop.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the Kenyan coin, then tap the bread.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! We appreciate money because it helps us buy items from shops.
interactions.retryHint: Choose money first, then choose a shop item.
